title: Pullback along a morphism of ringed topoi preserves the local properties of modules
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that pullback along a morphism of ringed topoi preserves seven local properties of modules: locally free, finite locally free, locally generated by sections, locally generated by r sections, finite type, quasi-coherent, and finite presentation. The proof reduces, via the discussion of intrinsic properties, to morphisms of ringed sites given by a left exact continuous functor u between sites with all finite limits; it then takes a module with one of the local properties, uses the final object and a covering {Y_i -> Y} on which the restriction has the corresponding global property, sets X_i = u(Y_i) to get a covering in the source site, and compares the resulting commutative diagram of localizations to transfer the global property, whence the local one (proof lines 3466-3498). H2: the reduction to the left exact continuous case and the transfer through the diagram of localizations are the substance.
